import ast,gzip,json,re
from hashlib import sha256
from pathlib import Path
from run_sqrt2_power_wave import target_for,formula_sha256
from run_sqrt2_power_pilot import ROOT
base=ROOT/'research/arithmetic-library/sqrt2-power/observations'
cases=[('AP051','exp-large-argument-ratio',1),('AP052','exp-large-argument-tail',1),('AP053','halving-prefix-decay',1),('AP054','exp-large-argument-decay',2),('AP055','exp-large-argument-truncation',1)]
driver='scripts/run_sqrt2_power_wave.py';current_ast=ast.parse((ROOT/driver).read_bytes());hash_cache={}
def functions(tree):return {n.name:n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef)}
current_functions=functions(current_ast)
def dump(node):return ast.dump(node,include_attributes=False)
def branch(function,case):
    found=[]
    for node in ast.walk(function):
        if isinstance(node,ast.If) and isinstance(node.test,ast.Compare):
            test=node.test
            if isinstance(test.left,ast.Name) and test.left.id=='identifier' and len(test.ops)==1 and isinstance(test.ops[0],ast.Eq) and len(test.comparators)==1 and isinstance(test.comparators[0],ast.Constant) and test.comparators[0].value==case:
                found.append([dump(x) for x in node.body])
    assert len(found)==1
    return found[0]
def actual_pin(name):
    if name not in hash_cache:
        path=ROOT/name;digest=sha256();size=0
        with path.open('rb') as stream:
            for block in iter(lambda:stream.read(65536),b''):digest.update(block);size+=len(block)
        hash_cache[name]=dict(bytes=size,sha256=digest.hexdigest())
    return hash_cache[name]
rows=[]
for case,slug,validation_version in cases:
    folder=base/('shared-wave-'+slug+'-v1');report_raw=(folder/'report.json').read_bytes();report=json.loads(report_raw)
    lean=json.loads((base/('shared-wave-'+slug+'-lean-v1')/'report.json').read_bytes())
    validation=json.loads((base/('shared-wave-'+slug+'-validation-v'+str(validation_version)+'.json')).read_bytes())
    assert report['status']=='fresh_ordinary_HA_checked' and lean['status']=='fresh_lean_checked' and validation['status']=='passed'
    assert validation['completed_batches']==validation['requested_batches']==10 and validation['max_workers']==1
    assert all(p['returncode']==0 and p['reason']=='exited' for p in validation['processes'])
    assert sum(int(re.search(r'\b(\d+) passed\b',p['stdout']).group(1)) for p in validation['processes'])==28
    members={}
    for phase,pin in report['process_records'].items():
        with gzip.open(folder/pin['path'],'rb') as stream:raw=stream.read(8*1024**2+1)
        assert len(raw)<=8*1024**2 and sha256(raw).hexdigest()==pin['raw_sha256']
        process=json.loads(raw);assert process['returncode']==0 and process['reason']=='exited'
        assert sha256(process['stdout'].encode()).hexdigest()==process['stdout_sha256']
        members[phase]=json.loads(process['stdout'])
    producer,replay=members['generation'],members['fresh_replay'];payload=producer['bundle'].encode()
    exact=formula_sha256(target_for(case));check=lean['checks'][0]
    assert len(lean['checks'])==1 and check['case']==case and check['independent_lean_checked'] is True
    assert sha256(payload).hexdigest()==producer['bundle_sha256']==replay['bundle_sha256']==check['bundle_sha256']
    assert exact==producer['target_ast_sha256']==replay['target_ast_sha256']==check['target_ast_sha256']
    assert check['report_sha256']==sha256(report_raw).hexdigest()
    assert replay['empty_context'] and replay['false_target_rejected'] and replay['forged_body_rejected']
    assert report['IR_parents_closed']==report['library_admissions']==0
    changed=[name for name,pin in report['source_pins'].items() if actual_pin(name)!=pin]
    assert set(changed)<={driver},changed
    pin=report['source_pins'][driver]
    with gzip.open(folder/report['source_snapshots'][driver],'rb') as stream:old=stream.read(pin['bytes']+1)
    assert len(old)==pin['bytes'] and sha256(old).hexdigest()==pin['sha256']
    old_functions=functions(ast.parse(old))
    for name in ('run','replay','check_forged_root_rejection','generation_phase_limits','replay_phase_limits'):
        assert dump(old_functions[name])==dump(current_functions[name]),name
    for name in ('pins','target_for','worker'):assert branch(old_functions[name],case)==branch(current_functions[name],case)
    rows.append(dict(case=case,target_sha256=exact,bundle_sha256=check['bundle_sha256'],bundle_bytes=len(payload),nodes=replay['local_nodes'],constructors=replay['proof_nodes'],generation_cpu=report['process_records']['generation']['resources']['cpu_seconds'],replay_cpu=report['process_records']['fresh_replay']['resources']['cpu_seconds'],lean_wall=lean['elapsed_wall_seconds'],focused_tests=8,protocol_guards=20,current_source_pin_count=len(report['source_pins']),controller_changed=bool(changed),controller_semantics_unchanged=True))
print(json.dumps(dict(authority='metadata_consistency_not_new_proof_authority',status='passed',rows=rows,total_additional_statements=172,total_distinct_local_statements=205,new_statement_regressions=1263,IR072_open=True,IR_parents_closed=0,library_admissions=0)))
